Asset type: five selected comic panels in one deterministic sequence sheet for CH04 CH04-S05
Primary request: Create a text-free 3-by-2 comic grid. The first five cells are the chronological story sequence below. The sixth cell is a quiet environment-only aftermath motif, never a duplicate character panel.
Scene/backdrop: outer observation blister inside the vertical sea in Veyr, a gravity-rationed city built beside a continent-high vertical ocean.

Composition/framing: exact clean 3-column by 2-row grid with strong black gutters; one readable moment per cell; varied camera distance; phone-readable silhouettes; the first five cells must read left-to-right top row then left-to-right bottom row.
Chronological cells:

Cell 4: Causal action: they anchor the heart and flatten against the rib as a juvenile keelback swims past; show footing, contact, rope or mechanism tension, and force direction.
Cell 5: Consequence and remaining state: the skate circles a wound on the larger creature; nothing resets between cells.
